_comment: Content for the simple pages that used to say 'Coming soon'. All details are MADE UP for the demo. Edit freely: each page is a list of cards; a card has a title, optional text, optional rows [label, value], and optional buttons. A button does ONE of: toast (show a short message), go (open a page), action (talk_to_pharmacist, open_chat, open_call, sign_out, copy_referral).

See a doctor.title: Virtual visit with a doctor or nurse practitioner
See a doctor.text: Book a video or phone visit for new symptoms, prescription renewals or questions your pharmacist can't answer. Demo only: no real booking is made.

buttons.label: Request a visit
buttons.toast: Visit requested (demo). The clinic will contact you to confirm.

See a doctor.title: Is it urgent?
See a doctor.text: For chest pain, trouble breathing, signs of a stroke, or very low or very high blood sugar with confusion, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency department now.

Contact us.title: Talk to the care team
rows: Mon to Fri 9 AM to 9 PM, Sat and Sun 10 AM to 6 PM

Contact us.title: In an emergency
Contact us.text: Call 911. The assistant and the pharmacy team can't respond to emergencies in real time.

Account tour.title: 1. Check up
Account tour.text: Your blood sugar and blood pressure at a glance. Start a short check-in by chat or by phone call.

Account tour.title: 2. Chat or call
Account tour.text: The assistant asks one question at a time. Anything worrying is flagged straight to your pharmacist, who stays in charge of your care.

Account tour.title: 3. Care plan
Account tour.text: After your check-in, your pharmacist reviews and approves a care plan in English and French.

Account tour.title: 4. Tasks
Account tour.text: Simple daily goals like walking or checking your feet. Tick them off as you go.

Account tour.title: 5. Medications, prescriptions and orders
Account tour.text: See what you take, upload a prescription, and track deliveries.

Promotions.title: No promotions right now
Promotions.text: Offers and discounts will appear here. You can share your referral code with friends in the meantime.

Referral code.title: Share Pillway with a friend
Referral code.text: Give this code to a friend when they sign up (demo).

Info and legal.title: About this demo
Info and legal.text: Hackathon prototype for the Brampton AI Innovator Challenge. Every patient, order and number is made up.

Info and legal.title: Privacy
Info and legal.text: Names and contact details are removed before anything is sent to the AI. The AI sees 'Patient A', not your name.

Info and legal.title: Important
Info and legal.text: The assistant is not a doctor or pharmacist and doesn't diagnose. Your pharmacist reviews flags and approves your care plan.
